// The companion workspace supplies two independently pinned packages.
module app;import { import "project.core".left; import "project.util".right; }.values;start values.token + values.delta;
summary: The consumer reads token=61 from sample.core and delta=47 from sample.util, yielding 108. The workspace stores exact versions and no capabilities. Offline restore requires the exact lock SHA-256.
title: Consume two explicit package values
